title: Home
description: A config-first Next.js template — modular, i18n-ready, accessibility-first.

hero.title: Ship client websites in a weekend
hero.subtitle: A modular Next.js foundation with i18n, SEO, a11y and Tailwind wired up — edit config, not code.

features.title: Everything wired up, nothing in the way

configFirst.title: Config-first
configFirst.body: A single src/config/ directory drives brand, routes, navigation, theme, SEO and llms.txt.

i18n.title: True i18n
i18n.body: next-intl with localized URL segments, hreflang, and a drop-in translation workflow.

a11y.title: Accessibility-first
a11y.body: WCAG 2.1 AA targets: skip links, focus rings, semantic landmarks, keyboard-first interactions.

cta.title: Ready to launch your next client site?
cta.body: Fork the template, edit the config, run pnpm dev. You're already halfway there.
